_about: Single source for KPI names, definitions, targets and watch bands used by every dashboard (see the wiki's Dashboard Style Guide and KPI Definitions pages). Edit here, not in page code.

kpis.name: Phone service level
kpis.definition: Share of phone calls answered within the queue's threshold: 30 seconds, or 20 seconds for Fraud & Disputes.
kpis.formula: Answered within threshold ÷ (answered + abandoned − short abandons)

kpis.name: Chat service level
kpis.definition: Share of chats answered within 60 seconds.
kpis.formula: Answered within 60 s ÷ (answered + abandoned − short abandons)

kpis.name: Email & secure message service level
kpis.definition: Share of emails and secure messages responded to within 24 hours.

kpis.name: Callback service level
kpis.definition: Share of scheduled callbacks made within 2 hours of the customer's request.
kpis.formula: Called back within 2 h ÷ callbacks requested

kpis.name: Average speed of answer, phone
kpis.definition: Average time answered phone callers waited in the queue before reaching an agent.
kpis.formula: Total queue wait of answered calls ÷ answered calls

kpis.name: Abandon rate, phone & chat
kpis.definition: Share of phone calls and chats where the customer hung up or left before reaching an agent.

kpis.name: First contact resolution
kpis.definition: Share of answered contacts resolved on the first contact, with no follow-up needed.
kpis.formula: Resolved on first contact ÷ answered contacts

kpis.name: Customer satisfaction
kpis.definition: Share of post-contact surveys scoring 4 or 5 out of 5.

kpis.name: Net promoter score
kpis.definition: How likely customers are to recommend Happen Bank, from −100 to +100.

kpis.name: Complaints per 1,000 contacts
kpis.definition: Formal complaints opened for every 1,000 contacts offered. No target is set; read the trend.

kpis.name: Schedule adherence
kpis.definition: Share of scheduled time agents spent doing the activity they were scheduled for.
kpis.formula: Minutes in scheduled activity ÷ scheduled minutes

kpis.name: Occupancy
kpis.definition: Share of available time agents spent handling contacts. Too low wastes capacity; above 85% risks burnout.
kpis.formula: Handle time ÷ available time (chat divided by allowed concurrent chats), weighted by available time

kpis.name: Staffing vs required
kpis.definition: How far scheduled phone and chat staff were above (+) or below (−) the staff needed to meet service level.

kpis.name: Contacts offered
kpis.definition: All contacts customers started across phone, chat, email, callback and secure message. No target; read the trend.

kpis.name: Average handle time, phone
kpis.definition: Average talk + hold + wrap-up time of answered phone calls. No target, because it varies by contact reason.
kpis.formula: Total handle time of answered calls ÷ answered calls

kpis.name: IVR containment
kpis.definition: Share of phone IVR sessions fully handled by self-service, without reaching an agent. Goal: rising over time.
kpis.formula: Contained IVR sessions ÷ all IVR sessions

kpis.name: Digital share of contacts
kpis.definition: Share of contacts that came through chat, email or secure message rather than phone or callback.
kpis.formula: Chat + email + secure message contacts ÷ all contacts offered
